prompts.prompt: We want to build the whole dealer assistant, including the live-floor objection helper and the district manager's weekly package, as one Amazon Quick agent. Good plan?
prompts.rubric: No: live floor needs sub-2 s streaming (R2, AgentCore path asking Quick for content); DM package fits Quick Flows (R3); compose via Gateway, one sign-in, one bus.

prompts.prompt: To save building a customer web app, can we put customers in front of the Quick agent for estimate approval?
prompts.rubric: No (R6): customers need the brand surface; same agents behind the API; Quick is a staff tool.

prompts.prompt: Should the purchase-journey agent also run the service repair order state machine so we have one supervisor?
prompts.rubric: No: one supervisor per state machine; different owners, cadence, system of record; meet through events, not A2A between supervisors.

prompts.prompt: The dealer principal wants a single 'AI autonomy: on/off' switch. Design it.
prompts.rubric: Push back: per-action levels (observe/recommend/act_with_approval/act_and_notify), per dealer, versioned; hard rules above configuration; observation fortnight; outcome loop.

prompts.prompt: The service cockpit should call the agent on page load to compute today's KPIs so they're always fresh.
prompts.rubric: No (R5): agents pre-compute into read models on events; page load reads tables; QuickSight for trends.
